title: Sprint V2-7: burn UX fixes + remove accrue_marks + genesis marks
brief: Fix 6 issues found during live TUI testing: auto-fill beneficiary, remove cross-domain burn restriction, wallet-lock error message, spendable/staked display, dynamic F7 label, remove per-block accrue_marks and add genesis premint marks.

decisions.fix1_beneficiary: Auto-fill BurnForm.beneficiary from selected receiver row (right panel) when opening F5. If no receiver selected, leave empty.
decisions.fix2_cross_domain_burn: Remove burn_ctx_source_dom check from crates/pwmd/src/tx_policy.rs. Burn is unilateral: sender's marks are debited from local shard; beneficiary is metadata only. Remove the 409 error block. Also remove the unused burn_ctx_source_dom fn from tx.rs and its tests.
decisions.fix3_wallet_lock_error: In submit_burn_mark (tx_submit.rs), when signing_key is None, return Err('Wallet is locked — press F3 to unlock') instead of a generic error.
decisions.fix4_balance_display: In TUI main account table, add a 'Staked' column or show 'spendable / staked' in the Balance cell. AcctRow.staked already exists. Format: '950.00 / 50.00 staked' or two separate columns.
decisions.fix5_f7_label: In footer/status line, replace two entries with one: 'F7/⇧F7 Stake/Unstake' (compact, no real-time Shift detection needed).
decisions.fix6_accrue_marks: Remove accrue_marks() and accrue_marks_v2() call sites from crates/pwm-core/src/chain.rs (both branches of is_legacy_policy). Keep the pub fn definitions in state.rs (they are pub and tested — no dead-code warning for pub items). At genesis init in State (wherever accounts are initialized from GRow), set marks = (row.bal / PWM_RAW_SCALE).min(u32::MAX as u128) as u32 so each preminted account starts with marks proportional to their premint balance.

acceptance_criteria: F5 burn form pre-fills beneficiary from selected receiver row.
BurnMark with cross-domain beneficiary is accepted by node (no 409).
Burn attempt with locked wallet shows 'Wallet is locked — press F3 to unlock'.
TUI account display shows both spendable and staked balance.
accrue_marks / accrue_marks_v2 NOT called in Chain::seal().
Genesis accounts receive marks = bal / 1_000_000 at init.
Naming script 0 violations on touched paths.
